chunks: By this chain of narration, he said: Al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon them both) said:
Indeed, lightning does not strike one who is remembering Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.الصاعقة: Lightning bolt; a thunderbolt or devastating strike
key_terms.ذاكرا: One who remembers, one engaged in dhikr (remembrance of God)

ai.seo_question: Does remembrance of Allah protect from lightning according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) teaches that remembrance of Allah (dhikr) provides divine protection, specifically that lightning will not strike a person engaged in remembrance of God. This hadith was recorded in the Amali of Shaykh al-Saduq, a compilation of lectures delivered in 368 AH, and highlights the protective spiritual power of constant God-consciousness.
